run.title: Our experiment · Guildhall full interior
run.notes: OUR GUILDHALL EXPERIMENT · Fixed-world full interior. All 305 saved states and 475,357 Gaussians per state; states hold between actual observed timestamps. Lossless sharing of the fixed room means about 31 MiB for the first state and 5 MiB per additional state (full download ≈ 1.7 GB; expanded local cache ≈ 11.5 GB). Viewpoint stays independent of time. Ghosted people, turn blur and uncovered surfaces remain; 87 frames failed motion-coverage checks. Viewer uses DC colour; fitted source views are not novel-view validation. Recording clock: original 50–75.333 s. No reconstruction of the edited transition or outro.
